import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    accounts = inputs["accounts"]
    txns = inputs["txns"]

    valid_accounts = set(accounts["account_id"])

    txns_f = txns[txns["account_id"].isin(valid_accounts)].copy()
    txns_f = txns_f.sort_values(by=["account_id", "txn_ts", "txn_id"], kind="mergesort")

    opening = dict(zip(accounts["account_id"], accounts["opening_balance"]))

    ledger_txn_ids = []
    ledger_balances = []

    fee_account_ids = []
    fee_dates = []
    fee_trigger_ids = []

    current_account = None
    bal = 0.0
    fee_dates_charged = set()

    for row in txns_f.itertuples(index=False):
        acct = row.account_id
        if acct != current_account:
            current_account = acct
            bal = opening.get(acct, 0.0)
            fee_dates_charged = set()

        bal = bal + row.amount

        if row.amount < 0 and bal < 0:
            tx_date = pd.Timestamp(row.txn_ts).normalize()
            if tx_date not in fee_dates_charged:
                bal = bal - 35.00
                fee_dates_charged.add(tx_date)
                fee_account_ids.append(acct)
                fee_dates.append(tx_date)
                fee_trigger_ids.append(row.txn_id)

        ledger_txn_ids.append(row.txn_id)
        ledger_balances.append(bal)

    txn_ledger = pd.DataFrame({
        "txn_id": pd.Series(ledger_txn_ids, dtype="int64"),
        "balance_after": pd.Series(ledger_balances, dtype="float64"),
    })

    fees = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": pd.Series(fee_account_ids, dtype="int64"),
        "fee_date": pd.Series(fee_dates, dtype="datetime64[us]"),
        "trigger_txn_id": pd.Series(fee_trigger_ids, dtype="int64"),
    })

    return {"txn_ledger": txn_ledger, "fees": fees}
